snippet.title: Exit Dream - Official Trailer (Free on Steam)
snippet.description:
Exit Dream is a free first-person psychological horror game on Steam, built around surreal dream puzzles, strange logic, and unsettling atmospheric exploration.

FREE on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4022490/Exit_Dream/

A short indie horror experience where each dream follows its own rules.

Release date: 21 Oct, 2025

#HorrorGame #PsychologicalHorror #Steam #IndieGame #ExitDream

Developed by emagnetic
